svg.title: Rain Negotiation Device — Future Museum exhibit card
svg.text: Folding umbrella · c. 2026 · faded nylon, steel,
Recovered beside office doors, these devices were
believed to negotiate rainfall. Wrist-loop wear
suggests owners carried them only when the sky looked
harmless. Their protective purpose was remembered most
clearly after they had been left behind.
Forecasting improved; remembering the device did not.
